risk_note: RV2 settlement (B2-04zg; D10-476; BR-FUND-04). Monthly bill catch-up: the daily seed and the worker start-up heal look back to the latest reached bill day whose bill month M is not generated yet and re-send that bill (bill_id = M, generated once; snapshot precondition judged on the catch-up day; earlier periods not chased); a bill answered deferred (D−1 asset snapshot not complete) completes the delivery and is re-sent later under the same singletonKey without consuming queue retries; a failing catch-up still raises the existing CouliSettleBillJobFailed alert. Judged from settle_bills / settle_jobs / queue state, Clock only. Frozen B2-04ze [AC-B2-04ze#7] / [#24] changed by test-change (D10-476 ②, single test(spec) commit, other 12 cases red_exempt).
